reasons: After deleting the sole proposition that uses the worked data-generating process, this definition has no load-bearing consumer and must be removed with that proposition.

The worked non-vacuity proposition is not consumed by any headline or supporting result.  The active review directive therefore requires its removal as motivation-only ballast; the explicit converse witnesses remain in the proof spine.
The retained calendar blocks are removed with the invalid calendar-score calibration.
The retained block count is unused after deletion of the calendar-score branch.
After deletion of the worked data-generating process and its sole proposition, the diagnostic law symbol is unreferenced and obsolete.
The globally selected calendar block score is removed because the frozen mixing assumptions did not decouple it.
The gap length belonged only to the deleted calendar-score interval branch; the anchor proof may introduce a blocking length as a proof intermediate without a catalog symbol.
The retained calendar-block length is unused after deletion of the calendar-score branch.
The repaired unit-history interval uses a deterministic bounded-range radius and no treated sample variance.
The calendar block variance is unused by the repaired bounded-range interval.
The repaired interval never divides by or studentizes with an estimated standard error.
The retained-block index is unused after deletion of the calendar-score branch.
The Gaussian critical value is unused by the repaired finite-sample bounded-range interval.
The no-log corollaries must identify independence as a property of the design conditional on the realized query, while preserving unrestricted response dependence within each unit history.
The no-log spacing assertion requires a formally named subclass that conditions design independence on the realized query and imposes no response-calendar independence.

Unconditional density bounds do not imply local occupancy after conditioning on a design-dependent event query.  The replacement supplies exactly the conditional support bound used by the anchor and spacing arguments.

The occupancy proof needs design mixing after conditioning on the realized query, but it does not need and must not assume conditional mixing of the responses.  Cross-unit history concentration permits arbitrary within-unit calendar dependence.

The calendar-score minimum was not valid because globally design-selected weights do not become independent block scores under raw-sequence beta mixing.  Unit histories are conditionally independent across units, so the bounded unit-history radius is the valid sampling calibration and already has the treated-noise order for local-constant weights.

estimand-functional-replace: The metadata must record the repaired query-conditional design assumptions, the unit-history-only interval, and the explicit rough-Holder scope after the inference algorithm changes.

comparator-promise-table-replace: The theorem-adjacent literature map now states, result by result, which classical object is closest and exactly which bounded-product, generated-query, full-covariance, or causal-bridge component is not supplied by it.  It also records that no dependent block calibration is used.
The interval no longer has a calendar-score branch, so its catalog description must identify the unit-history concentration construction.
Only conditional design mixing is needed for occupancy.  Responses remain arbitrarily dependent across calendar dates within a unit history and are handled by cross-unit concentration.

The former common unconditional density does not control occupancy after conditioning on a design-dependent event query.  The replacement names the conditional density required by the repaired assumption.

The proof spine now declares the full-covariance finite-support location lemma, and removes direct random-design assumptions that are unnecessary for the deterministic experiment and almost-sure bridge.

verdict.note: Accepted after mathematical audit: query-conditional design regularity, unit-history-only interval, conditional-iid subclass, positioning, rough-Holder scope, ballast and calendar-symbol deletions, plus the proved full-covariance donor pair. A fixed-query/a.e.-transfer scope patch follows before D0.5.
